verse:
R. Misericórdiam et judícium cantábo tibi, Dómine:
* Psallam et intéllegam in via immaculáta, quando vénies ad me.
V. Perambulábam in innocéntia cordis mei, in médio domus meæ.
R. Psallam et intéllegam in via immaculáta, quando vénies ad me.
notes: Imported from Divinum Officium source pending translation.
